items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: You know, you hear Johnny Hodges, you hear Benny Carter...

ctx.x: the way he played so beautiful, man. They never heard that kind of music in a saxophone. You know, you hear Johnny Hodges, you hear Benny Carter, you hear Earl Bostic, you hear Tab Smith, and you hear just about everybody. But you've never heard nothing in the classical veins like Leonard Fields.
There was a good saxophone player around New York that I happened to play with years ago named Jerome Pasquall. Did you ever hear him?
